cues.zh: 這裡有根號 3、根號 3，以及根號 2、根號 2，

cues.en: So there's like terms here and there's also root 5 Q and root 5.
cues.zh: 有同類項，也有根號 5 乘 q，和根號 5，

cues.en: Q And these are like terms over here.
cues.zh: 乘 q，這些也是同類項。

cues.en: So now what we can do is group these two sets of terms together.
cues.zh: 接著把這兩組項目整理在一起。

cues.en: So in the numerator we grouped together, or we pulled out, the square root of three from both of these terms.
cues.zh: 分子從兩項裡，提出共同的根號 3，

cues.en: That gives us square root of three times one plus the square root of five times q.
cues.zh: 得到根號 3，乘以括號裡的 1 加根號 5 乘 q。

cues.en: And in the denominator you get the same thing.
cues.zh: 分母也一樣，

cues.en: So that means that these two terms will cancel and we are left with the square root of three divided by the square root of two.
cues.zh: 因此這兩部分約掉，只剩根號 3 除以根號 2。

cues.en: Now your math teachers and the people who write your math textbooks and the people who wrote sympy
cues.zh: 數學老師、寫數學課本的人，以及 SymPy 的作者，

cues.en: believe that it is somehow ugly or wrong or just plain weird to have radical signs in the denominator.
cues.zh: 似乎覺得分母有根號很醜、不對，或很奇怪。

cues.en: Now why that is the case I honestly have no idea.
cues.zh: 老實說，我不知道為什麼，

cues.en: I don't see anything wrong with having square roots in the denominator.
cues.zh: 我不覺得分母有平方根有什麼問題。

cues.en: Nonetheless, many people don't like it, so it's common practice in mathematics to try to get rid of the square root in the denominator.
cues.zh: 但很多人不喜歡，所以數學常見做法是把分母的根號消掉。

cues.en: And in this case you can do that by multiplying both sides, so the top and the bottom of this fraction, by the square root of two.
cues.zh: 這裡可以把兩邊，應該說分子、分母，都乘以根號 2。

cues.en: And that gives you square root of two times the square root of 2 in the denominator, which of course is just 2, and the top is the square root of three times the square root of 2, which is the square root
cues.zh: 分母是根號 2 乘根號 2，當然等於 2；分子是根號 3 乘根號 2，也就是根號，

cues.en: of 6.
And this was the answer that you saw in Python so that's pretty funny.
cues.zh: 這就是 Python 裡看到的答案，很有趣。

cues.en: You saw that even though there is a variable Q In this expression the answer turns out to be the square root of six over two regardless of what Q is equal to.
cues.zh: 雖然式子有變數 q，但不管 q 等於多少，答案都是根號 6 除以 2。

cues.en: So in this video and the last video you learned about using simplify and Python to solve for a variable in an expression.
cues.zh: 這段和上一段，學到了用 SymPy、Python，解出運算式裡的變數。

cues.en: In the next video we are going to continue our adventures in learning how to use Python to understand algebra, and that's going to be done by expanding terms.
cues.zh: 下一段繼續用 Python 理解代數，透過展開項目來學習。

cues.en: I'm also going to show you some new concepts in sympy.
cues.zh: 也會介紹新的 SymPy 概念。

cues.en: So keep on watching.
cues.zh: 請繼續看。
